<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
* Reconcile records for removed resources by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24049
* Extend sandboxing to package processing by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24038
* Report analytics failure when debugging by @SMillerDev in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24059
* Fix pkgconf infinite reinstall after macOS upgrade by @rseleven in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24061
* Check extensionless scripts in style commands by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24063
* shims/super/cc: update swift path by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24065
* install_steps: fix sandbox write path resolution by @kronikpillow in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24067
* formula: provide fallback git identity in sandbox by @Moisan in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24066
* dev-cmd/advisory-match: fix test style by @samford in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24076
* Support Homebrew without sudo access by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24062
* Add as-brew-user and support MDM deployment by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24071
* Relax Git download credential sandboxing by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24064
* `dev-cmd/bump-formula-pr`: remove incorporated GitHub-based patches by @nandahkrishna in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24047
* Relocate prefixes split across x86-64 operands by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24080
* Deduplicate deprecation and sandbox warnings by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24078
* curl: use the last value of a repeated singleton header by @rawsun007 in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24053
* Restore PATH for sandboxed Git downloads by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24084
* Avoid recursive formulae and casks fallbacks by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24086
* cask/uninstall: skip signalling other users' processes by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24082
* Stabilise warning and GitHub artifact tests by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24093
* Type cask artifact options instead of `**options` by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24095
* upgrade: keep requested order in keg-only groups by @zbeekman in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24092
* cleanup: handle casks without a version in a given OS by @krehel in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24096
* [Fix] Clear cached receipts after source builds by @Hoshino-Yumetsuki in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24098
* Reject repeated SemVer prefixes by @andrew in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24099
* Bound SemVer input length by @andrew in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24100
* Keep fetch source time out of git checkouts by @daeho-ro in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24091
* livecheck: set a timeout for Git tag lookups by @SSakutaro in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24103
* shell: single-quote values for rc by @rawsun007 in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24105
* bump: order npm cooldown versions by semver by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24097
* sorbet: More `T.bind`s in test formula/caveats blocks by @issyl0 in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24106

## New Contributors
* @rseleven made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24061
* @kronikpillow made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24067
* @Hoshino-Yumetsuki made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24098

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/compare/7.0.6...7.0.7
